PluginData.Author: lolifamily
PluginData.Tooltip: Fixes LOD and terrain bugs, including artifacts on huge planets.
PluginData.Description:
Fixes LOD and terrain bugs of the game, most of them on by default:
- Edited terrain showing as holes in the distance - Model quality not changing the LOD distances of all models - Grid edges and projections fading between LODs too fast - Model rendering getting slower with every world load - Planet tree sectors leaking around ships - Raycasts of camera blocks, building and bullets missing terrain - Slow planet loading, slow terrain on 4096 pixel heightmaps - Bots waiting long for their paths in mountains
Planet terrain is computed in managed code, faster and more precise than the game's native code.
On huge planets also turn on Fix texture pixelation and Disable distance spherize, and Raise planet size limit for planets over 8000 km. Also optional: vegetation placement, slope detail and terrain LOD ranges.
